featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Team Pantaloons,

I recently visited your Pantaloons outlet at Bhayander Maxus Mall for shopping. Unfortunately, my experience was marred by several issues.

Firstly, Priyanka Gupta sold me 5 Allen Solly T-shirts, claiming a "buy 2 get 2 free" offer. However, at the billing counter, I was informed that not all Allen Solly items have this discount. This discrepancy caused confusion. The manager mentioned that offers change frequently, every 2-3 hours, but this wasn't communicated by Priyanka. This is blatant bluffing with customers, giving wrong information to lure sales.

Secondly, Krishna Mali, another salesman, was extremely rude and pushy. He insisted on selling items I wasn't interested in and showed zero interest in helping me with my actual choices.

The billing process was also lengthy, taking over 45 minutes to resolve. I had a small child with me who was hungry, which added to my frustration. This wasted my time and caused unnecessary stress.

As the outlet manager, I hope you take this feedback seriously and brief your team thoroughly to prevent such incidents in the future. Ensuring accurate information is given to customers and providing good customer service is crucial.

featured_reviews.name: Vedhas Brid
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely the worst customer experience I have ever had at any Reliance Trends store or any store. The manager, Pradeep Mundegar, has misguided me twice—first two months ago and again today—regarding ongoing offers and exchange policies.
When I questioned the mismatch in information, his behaviour became shockingly rude and intimidating. Instead of clarifying, he spoke in an arrogant tone and made comments that felt threatening and dismissive, telling me things like “This is how it is in Reliance Trends”
No customer should feel uncomfortable, threatened, or misled while shopping. This kind of behaviour from a store manager is completely unacceptable and needs immediate attention from higher management.
I strongly advise others to be cautious and double-check any offers or policies before trusting what is communicated at this store.
